portfolio_school_scheduler.message: school_scraper: live collection delegated to Core
portfolio_school_scheduler.outbound_school_fetch: not executed by this path; pinned by test_core_scrape_all_never_lists_or_fetches

interpretation: The same nine shared sources have a Portfolio scheduled cycle while Core is their native authority. The Portfolio school loop still wakes, but its authority guard delegates before network I/O. After handover, the nine start counts and the school wakeup must be zero while the 11 exclusive Portfolio sources remain active.

portfolio.window: from portfolio_worker StartedAt until its first Background: [All APIs] completed line
portfolio.why_one_startup_cycle_is_sufficient: startup, circadian and delegated/manual refreshes call the same registered update functions; run_cache_update checks harvest_source_enabled before constructing aiohttp.ClientSession
portfolio.effective_configuration: backend and worker must expose exactly the nine post_handover_expected.portfolio_disabled_sources values
portfolio.transferred_sources: each of the nine sources must emit at least one cache update SKIPPED — quiesced or transferred to core message and zero Starting <source> job data cache update messages; additional skips from concurrent user requests are allowed
portfolio.exclusive_sources: all eleven retained sources must emit a completed update attempt in the startup sweep and their health endpoints must remain HTTP 200 with content after the sweep
portfolio.school_scheduler: the periodic task must be _periodic_school_alerts calling retry_pending_alerts; no scheduled run_all_scrapeable or outbound school fetch; manual refresh remains covered separately
portfolio.failure: any transferred Starting message, missing disabled value, missing exclusive source, failed health/content check, or scheduled school collector keeps point 3 open

swissjob.window: startup of both recreated swissjob-backend and swissjob-worker
swissjob.effective_configuration: both containers must contain exactly fourteen disabled providers and two disabled scrapers from post_handover_expected
swissjob.registry: log_provider_status must report every transferred provider as disabled (core handover); get_all_providers/get_all_scrapers must exclude every transferred implementation while retaining non-transferred producers, including eight swiss_schools_* collectors
swissjob.failure: configuration mismatch between BFF/worker, a transferred registry instance, or loss of a non-transferred producer keeps point 3 open

post_handover_verification_gate.shared_postcondition: Core remains 17/17 healthy and serves the transferred sources while legacy producers are absent; do not infer success only from quiet logs
